fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable workflow key used as the metadata identity and developer-facing workflow identifier.

fields.name: moduleMetadata
fields.description: Owning SolidX module/package used for metadata persistence and distribution.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Human-facing workflow name shown in builder and execution screens.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: Optional dot-path grouping for workflows, such as ops.monitoring.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Workflow description and operational notes.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Workflow lifecycle status.

fields.name: definitionVersion
fields.description: Human-managed or seed-managed version string for the current workflow definition.

fields.name: definitionChecksum
fields.description: Checksum of the canonical definition JSON for change detection and execution traceability.

fields.name: definitionYaml
fields.description: Canonical workflow DSL YAML used for sharing, seeding, validation, and execution.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Optional array of tags for categorizing and searching workflows.

models.description: Stores one runtime execution of a workflow definition, including status, trigger information, inputs, outputs, definition snapshot, and error details.

fields.name: executionIdentifier
fields.description: System-generated readable execution identifier.

fields.name: workflowDefinition
fields.description: Workflow definition used to create this execution.

fields.name: workflowKey
fields.description: Snapshot of the workflow definition key for easier querying.

fields.name: workflowDisplayName
fields.description: Snapshot of the workflow display name at execution time.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current workflow execution status.

fields.name: triggerType
fields.description: Mechanism that started this workflow execution.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Execution start timestamp.

fields.name: finishedAt
fields.description: Execution finish timestamp.

fields.name: durationMs
fields.description: Execution duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: inputPayload
fields.description: Runtime inputs supplied to the workflow execution.

fields.name: outputPayload
fields.description: Flow-level outputs produced by the workflow execution.

fields.name: definitionVersion
fields.description: Definition version used by this execution.

fields.name: definitionChecksum
fields.description: Definition checksum used by this execution.

fields.name: definitionSnapshot
fields.description: Exact workflow JSON definition used for this execution.

fields.name: errorSummary
fields.description: Human-readable execution failure summary.

fields.name: errorDetails
fields.description: Structured execution error payload.

fields.name: requestedByUserId
fields.description: User or actor id that requested the execution, if available.

fields.name: workflowStepExecutions
fields.description: Step execution records produced by this workflow execution.

fields.name: workflowExecutionLogs
fields.description: Log records emitted by this workflow execution.

fields.name: workflowExecutionArtifacts
fields.description: Artifacts produced by this workflow execution.

models.description: Stores one node or step runtime execution within a workflow execution, including status, timing, input and output snapshots, retry or attempt state, and error details.

fields.name: stepExecutionKey
fields.description: Stable unique key for this step execution, assigned by the runtime.

fields.name: workflowExecution
fields.description: Parent workflow execution this step belongs to.

fields.name: nodeId
fields.description: Node id from the workflow definition DSL.

fields.name: nodeName
fields.description: Human-readable node name captured at execution time.

fields.name: nodeKind
fields.description: Broad node category.

fields.name: nodeType
fields.description: Registered node type id such as log.write, http.request, if, forEach, or parallel.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current step execution status.

fields.name: attemptNumber
fields.description: Current attempt number for this step execution.

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of retries attempted for this step.

fields.name: maxRetries
fields.description: Maximum retry count resolved for this step.

fields.name: parentNodeId
fields.description: Parent control or subflow node id when this step is nested.

fields.name: parentStepExecutionKey
fields.description: Parent step execution key for nested runtime structures.

fields.name: sequenceNumber
fields.description: Traversal or scheduling sequence number within the workflow execution.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Step start timestamp.

fields.name: finishedAt
fields.description: Step finish timestamp.

fields.name: durationMs
fields.description: Step duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Timeout resolved for this step in milliseconds.

fields.name: inputPayload
fields.description: Input payload resolved for this step execution.

fields.name: outputPayload
fields.description: Output payload produced by this step execution.

fields.name: runtimeContext
fields.description: Scoped runtime context used while executing this step.

fields.name: nodeSnapshot
fields.description: Snapshot of the workflow node definition used for this step execution.

fields.name: errorSummary
fields.description: Short human-readable error summary for failed steps.

fields.name: errorDetails
fields.description: Structured error details captured for failed steps.

models.description: Stores timestamped log entries emitted during workflow and step execution for diagnostics, traceability, and runtime observability.

fields.name: logKey
fields.description: Stable unique key for this workflow execution log entry.

fields.name: workflowExecution
fields.description: Workflow execution this log entry belongs to.

fields.name: workflowStepExecution
fields.description: Optional step execution this log entry belongs to when the log is node-scoped.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Log severity level.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable log message.

fields.name: eventType
fields.description: Structured event type such as execution.started, step.failed, or retry.scheduled.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source component or runtime subsystem that emitted the log entry.

fields.name: nodeId
fields.description: Workflow node id associated with this log entry, when applicable.

fields.name: nodeType
fields.description: Registered node type associated with this log entry, when applicable.

fields.name: sequenceNumber
fields.description: Monotonic ordering number for log entries within the execution.

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was emitted.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Structured context for this log entry.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional metadata captured with this log entry.

models.description: Stores artifacts produced during workflow or step execution, including files, payload snapshots, URLs, checksums, and metadata.

fields.name: artifactKey
fields.description: Stable unique key for this execution artifact.

fields.name: workflowExecution
fields.description: Workflow execution this artifact belongs to.

fields.name: workflowStepExecution
fields.description: Optional step execution that produced this artifact.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable artifact name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional artifact description.

fields.name: artifactType
fields.description: Artifact storage or payload category.

fields.name: nodeId
fields.description: Workflow node id that produced this artifact, when applicable.

fields.name: nodeType
fields.description: Registered node type that produced this artifact, when applicable.

fields.name: storageProviderKey
fields.description: Storage provider key when this artifact is stored outside the database.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: External URI, storage path, or download URL for the artifact.

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original or generated file name for file artifacts.

fields.name: mimeType
fields.description: MIME type for file or binary artifacts.

fields.name: sizeBytes
fields.description: Artifact size in bytes, when known.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: Artifact checksum or content hash, when available.

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the artifact was produced.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Inline structured artifact payload for small DB-stored artifacts.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional artifact metadata.

models.description: Stores each trigger firing or trigger evaluation attempt, including trigger identity, status, payload, timing, and the workflow execution created from the trigger when applicable.

fields.name: triggerExecutionKey
fields.description: Stable unique key for this trigger execution attempt.

fields.name: workflowDefinition
fields.description: Workflow definition whose trigger fired or was evaluated.

fields.name: workflowExecution
fields.description: Workflow execution created by this trigger, when a run was started.

fields.name: triggerId
fields.description: Trigger id from the workflow definition DSL.

fields.name: triggerName
fields.description: Human-readable trigger name captured at execution time.

fields.name: triggerType
fields.description: Registered trigger type id or broad trigger category.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current trigger execution status.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: Whether this trigger evaluation matched and should start a workflow execution.

fields.name: firedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the trigger fired or was received.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when trigger processing started.

fields.name: finishedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when trigger processing finished.

fields.name: durationMs
fields.description: Trigger processing duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source system, scheduler, webhook endpoint, or event bus that produced the trigger.

fields.name: correlationId
fields.description: External correlation id for linking trigger attempts to upstream events.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: Optional idempotency key used to prevent duplicate trigger handling.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Trigger payload, request body, schedule context, or event data.

fields.name: triggerSnapshot
fields.description: Snapshot of the trigger definition used for this trigger execution.

fields.name: errorSummary
fields.description: Short human-readable error summary for failed trigger executions.

fields.name: errorDetails
fields.description: Structured error details captured for failed trigger executions.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional trigger execution metadata.

models.description: Stores encrypted global secrets available to workflow expressions.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Global secret key used in workflow expressions, for example smtp.password.
fields.regexPatternNotMatchingErrorMsg: Secret key must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Human-facing secret name shown in the admin UI.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Operational notes describing where this secret is used.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Secret value. The admin-supplied value is encrypted before it is stored.

fields.name: valueType
fields.description: How the decrypted value should be coerced for workflow runtime usage.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Secret lifecycle status.

fields.name: lastRotatedAt
fields.description: When this secret was last rotated.

fields.name: lastAccessedAt
fields.description: When this secret was last resolved by workflow runtime.
